facts.fact: ONECI's civil-status project lead said on 11 August 2026 that birth data entered by health staff on the new digital terminals is transmitted in real time to the civil-status office, notably the mairies or sous-préfectures, for handling of the declaration; no count of mairies is given and the mairie's own connection is not described.
facts.system: terminaux numériques (logiciel de collecte des données d'état civil)

systems.platform: smartphone with civil-status data collection software developed by ONECI
systems.tiers: health structures, sending to civil-status offices in mairies and sous-préfectures; 283 terminals handed to health structures of the Tonkpi region on 11 August 2026

note: The one fact is inferred from data arriving in real time at the mairie's civil-status office; the document does not say how the mairie receives it.
